entries.notes: is based on Karl Heinrich Graun 's Passion cantata "Ein Lämmlein geht und tragen die Schuld" (so-called "Kleine Passion" (GraunWV B:VII:4), Braunschweig before 1735) with Georg Philipp Telemann 's opening chorus, "Wer ist der, so von Edom kömmt" TVWV 1:1585 (from the Palmarum cantata of the French vintage), and the following chorale movement for "Christus, der uns selig macht" (from D to E transposed final chorale of the same cantata); the following movements (3rd–18th) are all by Graun.
